stem: At the moment a forward contract is initiated at its no-arbitrage forward price, the value of the long position is:
options: the spot price minus the forward price
the present value of the forward price
explanation: The forward price is chosen so that neither party has an advantage, so the contract has zero value to both sides at initiation.

rationale.A: Correct. No-arbitrage pricing sets the forward price so that the initial value is zero.
rationale.B: Incorrect. At initiation S0 − F0 is generally negative (F0 includes carry) and is not the contract's value.
rationale.C: Incorrect. The present value of the forward price equals the carry-adjusted spot price; it is a component of value, not the value of the contract.

stem: An investor entered a nine-month long forward on a non-dividend-paying share when the spot price was USD 80 and the annual risk-free rate was 3%. Three months later the share trades at USD 83 and the rate is unchanged. The value of the long forward is closest to:

rationale.A: Incorrect. 1.21 = 83 − 81.79 fails to discount the forward price over the remaining six months.
rationale.B: Incorrect. 3.00 = 83 − 80 compares the new spot with the old spot and ignores the carry built into the forward price.

stem: The spot exchange rate is 1.1000 USD per EUR. The one-year risk-free rate is 4.5% in USD and 3.0% in EUR (annual compounding). The no-arbitrage one-year forward rate in USD per EUR is closest to:
explanation: With USD as the price currency and EUR as the base currency: F0 = 1.1000 × 1.045 / 1.03 = 1.1160.

rationale.A: Incorrect. 1.0842 inverts the rates, putting the EUR rate in the numerator.
rationale.C: Incorrect. 1.1495 = 1.1000 × 1.045 ignores the interest earned on the base currency (EUR).

stem: A one-year forward on a non-dividend-paying share was initiated when the spot price was USD 120 and the annual risk-free rate was 4%. Six months later the spot price is USD 115 and the rate is unchanged. The value of the short forward position (in USD) is closest to:

rationale.A: Correct. The short gains when the spot falls: −(115 − 122.376) = 7.38.
rationale.B: Incorrect. −7.38 is the value of the long position, not the short.
rationale.C: Incorrect. 5.00 = 120 − 115 ignores the carry in the forward price and discounting.
